# Altfield

> A Shopify app that writes the SEO titles, meta descriptions, image alt text,
> product attributes and taxonomy categories a catalogue is missing, from each
> product's own data. Every proposal is approved by the merchant before it is
> written, and every run reverts in one click.

Made by NKD Pizza LTD, trading as NKD Software, Dublin, Ireland. Contact
info@nkd.ie. Installed from the Shopify App Store at
https://apps.shopify.com/altfield.

## Pricing

All plans include every feature. The only difference is how many products can
be processed, and a product counts once per run.

- Free: $0/month, 25 products a month
- Starter: $19/month, 750 products a month
- Growth: $49/month, 6,000 products a month
- Pro: $149/month, 25,000 products a month

Paid plans include a 7-day trial with a smaller allowance. Billing is handled
by Shopify; Altfield never sees a card.

## What it will not do

- It does not overwrite values a merchant wrote themselves unless that is
  chosen for a given run; a normal run fills only empty fields.
- It does not keep anything on uninstall: text it wrote lives in the
  merchant's own Shopify product records.
- It does not request customer or order scopes, so it holds no customer,
  order or payment data.

## Data handling

Product text (title, description, type, vendor, tags, existing SEO fields and
metafields) is sent to Anthropic's API to generate a proposal, plus one
product photograph where the description is too thin to work from. Anthropic
does not train on data submitted through its API. Altfield's own data is held
in the European Union, in Amsterdam.
